base: Create a standalone carpet albedo artwork texture for an elegant auction house game, inspired by luxurious palace, museum, hotel and library interiors. Orthographic TOP DOWN exactly, flat and undistorted, pattern aligned square to image edges. Carpet only, absolutely no room, floor, furniture, frame, perspective, folded edges, cast shadows or lighting gradients. Full rectangular carpets fill canvas edge to edge; oval and round carpets only have transparent exterior. Fine woven textile fibers and subtle antique wear but sharp readable decorative motifs, rich harmonious subdued colors, no text or watermark. This is a rug TEXTURE not a photograph of a rug in a room.
